name: poke-tactics
description: Autochess de Pokémon estilo TFT con multijugador por salas (fangame gratuito)

scripts.test:all: node test/smoke.js && node test/augments.js && playwright test
scripts.check: node -e "for(const f of ['public/augments.js','public/game.js'])require('vm').createScript(require('fs').readFileSync(f,'utf8'),{filename:f})" && node --no-warnings --experimental-vm-modules -e "new (require('vm').SourceTextModule)(require('fs').readFileSync('public/board3d.js','utf8'),{identifier:'board3d.js'})" && echo sintaxis-ok
